prompts.title: Renaissance Noblewoman Painterly Portrait AI Prompt
prompts.prompt: Use the uploaded image for face and identity reference only. Create an elegant Renaissance-inspired painterly digital portrait of a refined noblewoman with soft luminous porcelain skin and delicate features. Her blonde/brown curly hair is styled in an intricate classical updo with braided volume, soft sculpted curls, and subtle pearl accents, rendered naturally with believable texture and graceful flow, not artificial or overly glossy. She wears an ornate antique gold necklace and matching drop earrings set with deep royal-blue sapphire gemstones, paired with a luxurious ivory satin gown and a rich deep-crimson velvet shawl draped gracefully around her shoulders. Show her in a tight chest-up three-quarter portrait, gazing softly to the side with a calm aristocratic expression, one graceful hand resting gently beneath her chin. Use a nearly black painterly studio background, slightly lighter behind the subject, with soft dramatic chiaroscuro lighting that gives depth and gentle luminosity to the face, hair, satin, velvet, and jewelry. Emphasize refined skin, natural elegant curls, rich velvet folds, luminous satin sheen, and intricate gemstone details. Style and mood: polished painterly realism, Renaissance fine-art aesthetic, serene, regal, timeless, romantic, graceful, intimate, moody, and museum-quality. Rich color harmony, subtle artistic softness, luxurious visual depth, and a sophisticated classical atmosphere. 4:5 aspect ratio.

prompts.title: Portrait of Success
prompts.prompt:
Create a photorealistic, highly detailed wide-angle shot of a  man with styled hair, sitting completely relaxed in a sleek black and silver leather chair. He is wearing a sharply tailored black suit with a crisp, light gray button-down shirt, unbuttoned at the collar, paired with black dress socks and polished black leather oxford shoes. A luxury golden watch is visible on his left wrist. He is smiling subtly and confidently, gazing toward camera. The setting is an ultra-luxurious, modern high-rise penthouse with reflective polished white marble flooring. To the left, floor-to-ceiling windows showcase a stunning sunset view of the Kuala Lumpur cityscape, prominently featuring the Petronas Twin Towers. Directly behind the man on a white marble wall hangs a colossal, vibrant mixed-media watercolour, chest-up portrait of himself, framed in gold, featuring expressive brushstrokes, abstract washes of pink and teal, and metallic gold leaf splatters. The interior is decorated with 2 perfectly manicured bonsai trees in dark ceramic pots, a modern gold ring chandelier, and a sleek console table. The scene is illuminated by soft, warm golden hour sunlight pouring through the windows, creating dramatic, elegant reflections on the glossy marble floor. Cinematic lighting, Architectural Digest editorial style, 8K ultra-high resolution, sharp focus on the subject, ray-traced reflections, hyper-detailed textures, exceptional clarity, and premium photorealistic quality.
Aspect ratio 4:5

prompts.title: Parisian Grace
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for face and identity reference. Preserve exact facial structure, proportions, skin tone, asymmetry, and natural details — no identity drift.
Create a highly stylized, ultra-detailed vintage Parisian chic editorial portrait in a hand-painted fashion illustration style blended with refined digital painting. The result must feel like a real artist-painted artwork with visible brush strokes — not clean or synthetic AI output.
Composition & Pose
Chest-up portrait, soft three-quarter profile.

Body angled slightly left, face turned toward the right (off-frame), creating a natural twist.

Head gently tilted, neck elongated and elegant.

Subject occupies ~80% of the frame.

Lower portion dissolves into background using loose, visible brush strokes (no hard edges).
Expression
Soft, natural smile with subtle visible teeth.

Warm, lively, effortless — not posed.

Preserve natural asymmetry.
Eyes (Primary Focus)
Expressive eyes with deep, multi-layered iris detail.

Soft painterly gradients, subtle integrated catchlights.

Eyelashes slightly irregular and organic.
Skin Rendering
Painterly, not airbrushed.

Soft layered blending with visible tonal transitions.

Natural texture retained (no plastic smoothness).

Warm blush on cheeks and nose, slight tonal variation across face.

Edges remain soft and “lost-and-found,” not sharply defined.
Hair
Deep brunette, structured vintage curls.

Thick, sculpted ringlets with clear depth separation.

Rendered using layered brush strokes (not hyper-real strands).

Controlled highlights, dense and weighty form.
Clothing & Fabric
Black beret: matte wool/felt, deep charcoal tone (not pure black), soft diffused folds.
Blazer: layered editorial black —
charcoal base, soft grey mid-tones in folds, subtle cool (blue/purple) undertones in shadows and warm neutral tones in highlights.
Fabric appears soft yet structured, with a slightly smooth wool-blend feel — not stiff, not glossy.
Surface shows subtle fabric grain and gentle light absorption, giving a refined matte finish.
Natural fold behavior:
Soft, flowing folds around shoulders and chest
Gradual tonal transitions (no harsh creases)
Fabric drapes naturally with slight weight
Buttons clearly visible:
Matte black buttons integrated into the blazer
Slight highlight on edges, but not reflective or glossy
Subtle depth and stitching indication (not overly sharp)
Edge handling:
Fabric edges remain slightly soft and painterly
Lower portion dissolves into dry brush strokes blending into background
Accessories
Pearl drop earrings with soft luminous finish.

Metallic floral stud with delicate highlights, slightly painterly (not sharp).
Lighting
Soft directional light from front-left.

Natural highlight roll-off on face.

Gentle shadows under jaw and neck.

No harsh contrast or flat lighting.
Background
Off-white base with visible hand-painted brush strokes.

Colors: warm peach, soft lavender, muted gold.

Layered, textured, imperfect brushwork (no smooth gradients).

Subtle golden specks blended into paint.
Painterly Style Rules
Visible brush strokes across entire image.

Soft, broken edges — no sharp outlines.

Forms defined through tonal blending, not linework.

Avoid hyper-sharp or overly polished AI finish.
Texture & Color
Subtle paper/canvas grain.

Warm editorial color grading.

Deep, dimensional blacks (not flat).

Luminous, natural skin tones.
Output
Vertical, 4:5 aspect ratio.

Ultra-detailed.

Sharp focus on face, gradual painterly falloff toward edges.
